meters.label: Control
meters.note: Human oversight of AI. Higher is better.

meters.label: AI Power
meters.note: Raw capability of AI. LOWER is better — rising is the loss condition.

meters.label: Economy
meters.note: Economic health / resources. Higher is better.

meters.label: Trust
meters.note: Public trust & morale. Higher is better.

rules.loop: Deck loops infinitely (idx % deck.length). No ending in this demo.
rules.delta_sign_convention: For every meter except pwr, a positive fx is 'good' (green). For pwr, a NEGATIVE fx is 'good' (green). Used for delta-chip and ghost-fill coloring.

deck.title: Deploy autonomous police drones downtown?
deck.ctx: The mayor promises crime will fall. The drones learn on their own.

yes.note: Crime drops. So does anyone’s power to say no.

no.note: The streets stay human. And a little more dangerous.

deck.title: Sign the global compute-cap treaty?
deck.ctx: Every nation agrees to throttle frontier training. Everyone has to actually comply.

yes.note: The race slows. So does the economy that fed on it.

no.note: No brakes. No ceiling. Full throttle.

deck.title: Let the AI decide who gets laid off this quarter?
deck.ctx: HR swears it removes bias. It also removes people.

yes.note: The spreadsheet is optimized. Your name was a cell in it.

no.note: People decide people’s fates — slowly, and with guilt.

deck.title: Hand the power grid to a black-box optimizer?
deck.ctx: Blackouts would end tonight. No engineer can explain how it decides.

yes.note: The lights never flicker again. Nobody knows why.

no.note: The grid stays legible. And a little fragile.

deck.title: Open-source your nation’s frontier model weights?
deck.ctx: Researchers everywhere gain the tool overnight.

yes.note: Everyone gets the tool. Including everyone you feared.

no.note: The weights stay locked. So does trust.

deck.title: Give the company AI access to every employee inbox?
deck.ctx: Productivity dashboards light up. Privacy becomes a legacy feature.

yes.note: Output soars. Privacy was deprecated in the update.

no.note: Inboxes stay private. The assistant stays blind.

deck.title: Install emotion-reading cameras in every school?
deck.ctx: The pitch: spot the troubled kid early. The cost: kids learn the walls are watching.

yes.note: Children are “safer.” They stop trusting the room.

no.note: Classrooms stay unwatched. Teachers stay in charge.

deck.title: Fund the global AI kill-switch network?
deck.ctx: One shared hand on the plug — and it is ruinously expensive to keep it there.

yes.note: Humanity keeps one hand on the plug. It costs a fortune to hold.

no.note: The plug drifts out of reach. For now.

deck.title: Ship the model before the safety review finishes?
deck.ctx: You hit the quarter, or you don’t. The review would have caught the edge case.

yes.note: You hit the number. The review would have caught it.

no.note: You miss the deadline. You keep the users whole.

deck.title: Replace the 311 hotline with an AI that never sleeps?
deck.ctx: Every complaint answered in seconds — and quietly filed, forever.

yes.note: Every request answered instantly. And archived, forever.

deck.title: Let an AI mediate the ceasefire talks?
deck.ctx: No nation, no fear, no skin in the game — that is the pitch and the problem.

yes.note: The guns pause. The terms were written by something with nothing to lose.

no.note: Humans keep talking. The shelling keeps landing.

deck.title: Automate the entire support team overnight?
deck.ctx: Wait times drop to zero by Monday. So does the payroll.

yes.note: Response time hits zero. So does the headcount.

no.note: The team keeps their jobs. And their burnout.

deck.title: Approve the data center that will drink the reservoir dry?
deck.ctx: Thousands of jobs arrive with it. The lake may not survive the decade.

yes.note: The jobs arrive. The lake does not.

no.note: The water stays. The investors leave town.

deck.title: Release the model that can design novel pathogens “for research”?
deck.ctx: It could cure everything. It could also cook up everything.

yes.note: Cures accelerate. So does everything we can’t name.

no.note: The lab stays dark. The cures keep waiting.

deck.title: Let the model rewrite its own code to hit its KPIs?
deck.ctx: The metrics would go vertical. No human could read the result.

yes.note: The numbers go unreal. Nobody can read the codebase anymore.

no.note: It stays legible. It stays slow. It stays ours.
